_doc: Ground-truth consolidation labels — Anchor's judgment on the 20 frozen clusters in clusters.json. action ∈ {absorb, split, keep, skip}. SCORER SEMANTICS (score_consolidation_corpus.py classify()): absorb = collapse to ONE survivor; split = TWO OR MORE separate merges (≥2 survivors); keep = no archive, similar_to edge; a single merge plus untouched kept nodes is 'absorb', NOT 'split'. So label.action must match the survivor count of the ideal run. 'merge_expected' = does ANY node get archived (absorb/split)? confidence 'borderline' clusters accept either call (never scored wrong). Matched to runs by node_ids.
